name: Charity (Zakat and Sadaqah)

definition_by_age.4: Giving something to someone who needs it.
definition_by_age.6: Charity means giving what you can to help others, a practice Islam highly values.
definition_by_age.8: Zakat is obligatory giving, and sadaqah is voluntary charity — both are ways Islam asks us to care for those in need.

learning_objective: Children can name one way to help someone who has less.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_012). Helping->Blessing fits charity directly — moved off pattern_012 to resolve its collision with concept_community.

hd_010.reasoning: Directly defines charity broadly including a smile.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Donating a valued toy (not surplus) is a real helping/blessing shape.
Giving what little you have during a collection is a natural-lesson shape, no adult mediation needed.
